verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI privacy docs state that its AI features are opt-in and do not store or train on user data, and that neither Graphite nor its subprocessors use customer data to train models. They add that Anthropic and OpenAI are contractually barred from doing so. Organizations can also request a complete block of all AI features, so no training occurs by default and the user needs no extra action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training commitment, and a self-serve control for the org-wide AI block (it currently requires emailing support).
